g.text: A literal is a propositional variable or the negation
A formula is in disjunctive normal form (DNF)
iff it is a disjunction of conjunctions of literals.
A formula is in conjunctive normal form (CNF)
iff it is a conjunction of disjunctive clauses.
A DNF lists alternative ways to satisfy the formula; a CNF lists requirements
that all have to be met. Resolution needs CNF.
